newsitem.title: USA: Mylan gains FDA approval for 2 generic drugs.
newsitem.headline: Mylan gains FDA approval for 2 generic drugs.

text.p: Mylan Laboratories Inc on Wednesday said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) gave its approval to the company to manufacture and market two generic drugs.

The first product, Pentoxifylline Extended Release Tablets, is the generic version of Hoechst Marion Roussel's Trental, used to treat leg pain in patients with chronic vascular disease. Hoechst Marion is a unit of Hoechst AG.

Mylan will also make and market Trifluoperazine Hydrochloride tablets in four strengths. The product is the generic version of SmithKline Beecham Plc's Stelazine, an anti-anxiety agent used in the treatment of psychotic disorders.
